Container.Name: gameserver-panel
Container.Overview: Web control panel (start/stop/update/configure/console) for game servers. First module: The Ship: Remasted. Keep the panel port LAN-only; only forward the game ports.

Config.Name: Watchtower
Config.Description: Label so Watchtower (--label-enable) keeps this container updated

Config.Name: Panel password
Config.Description: Admin password (min 8 chars). Optional once OIDC is set up.

Config.Name: Panel port
Config.Description: Web UI port (host networking). LAN only.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Leave empty for a public client (PKCE only)

Config.Name: OIDC public URL
Config.Description: How your browser reaches the panel, e.g. http://tower:8080. Redirect URI is this + /auth/callback

Config.Name: OIDC allowed users
Config.Description: Comma list of usernames/emails allowed in

Config.Name: OIDC allowed groups
Config.Description: Comma list of groups/realm roles allowed in
